stations.title: Imogen
stations.say: Why did a slip say note: undefined?

stations.title: Order code
stations.text: Reads any property it hopes is there.

captions: Imogen asks why a customer's slip at Oakhollow said note: undefined.
Order OK-1043 has no gift note, and the code read one anyway.
You write the shape of an order as a type: what it has, what may be missing, what stays.
Now order OK-1043 gets a plain slip, and the compiler knows every order's shape.
Every object at the shop now has a shape the compiler checks.
